title: RegistryAuth asked per token request, not fixed at construction
why: ECR passwords expire after about 12 hours; a fixed field cannot be replaced, so expiry handling lives in one provider instead of every caller
alternative: Rebuild or mutate the store when credentials change - rejected: spreads expiry handling across fetch, push and train

intent: Hand-written SigV4 signer checked against AWS test vectors

title: SigV4 verified against AWS's published test suite, scoped to STS and ECR
why: A signer tested only against our own fake would agree with its own mistakes; AWS publishes expected signatures (get-vanilla, post-x-www-form-urlencoded) that fail on any canonicalisation or key-derivation bug. Scope is limited to a / path and simple queries, which is all STS and ECR need.
alternative: Round-trip test against a fake AWS endpoint only - rejected: cannot catch an error shared by signer and fake. Full SigV4 including S3 path rules - rejected: unused code in a startup tool
